caption: The drawing depicts a horse harness or bridle component, constructed primarily from brown leather straps that are joined by silver or metallic decorative elements. The leather straps are illustrated in varying widths and curve around one another to form a loop and several branches, suggesting different functional sections of tack. Large, silver-colored plates with intricate etched or engraved floral and geometric patterns are prominently attached to the broader sections of leather at several spots. Circular and oval metallic fixtures, some with raised centers and engraved designs, are also featured, along with a central elaborate concho and a rectangular buckle on one end of the strap. The design and decorations indicate craftsmanship detail, and the objects are set against a plain, tan-beige background. The artist's signature, "Han Blakely," appears in red in the lower right quadrant of the page.
title: Headstall
